property_summary: For any caller address, calling setOwner succeeds (returns / does not revert) when the caller equals the current owner; the mutant that changes the onlyOwner check to require(msg.sender == address(0)) will cause setOwner to revert for legitimate owner callers (non-zero), so the reference always allows the current owner to call setOwner but the mutant blocks those calls for many inputs.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner require to compare against address(0) so the modifier always reverts unless owner is zero, preventing setOwner from succeeding normally.
